slides.title: Welcome to AV Apparel
slides.goal: Set culture and expectations before catalog work.
bullets: Apparel is customer-facing — copy and inventory truth matter.
Start in Lane A/B until you have two clean PRs.
Your first win is a small, reviewable catalog improvement.

slides.title: Contributor lanes
slides.goal: Know what you can touch on day one.
bullets: Lane A: markdown, copy, images, catalog entries.
Lane B: static UI and accessibility fixes.
Lane C: backend/infra — elevated access only.
